title: Tiananmen Square Protests
description:
In the spring of 1989, student-led demonstrations in **Tiananmen Square**, Beijing, called for political reform and democracy.

The protests grew to involve millions of people across China. On June 4, 1989, the Chinese government declared martial law and violently suppressed the movement.

The iconic image of "Tank Man" blocking a column of tanks became a symbol of peaceful resistance worldwide.
